name: copilot-lm-bridge-extension
description: Local HTTP bridge from external tools to VS Code Language Model API.

commands.title: Copilot LM Bridge: Request Copilot Consent
Copilot LM Bridge: Run Pipeline Fix For Active File
Copilot LM Bridge: Auto-Detect and Fix Issues

copilotLmBridge.port.description: Local HTTP server port for the bridge.

copilotLmBridge.host.description: Host interface for the bridge server.

copilotLmBridge.autoStart.description: Automatically start bridge server when VS Code starts.

copilotLmBridge.projectRoot.description: Target project root directory to fix. Relative paths resolve from the currently opened workspace.

copilotLmBridge.assemblyLineRoot.description: Directory that contains the assembly_line engine (src/ and tools/). Empty value means current workspace.

copilotLmBridge.outputDir.description: Output directory for patch.diff, evidence report, and run_log. Relative paths resolve from projectRoot.

copilotLmBridge.proxyClientPath.description: Path to lm_proxy_http_client.py. Relative paths resolve from assemblyLineRoot.

copilotLmBridge.setPythonPath.description: When enabled, set PYTHONPATH=<assemblyLineRoot>/src automatically if that folder exists.

copilotLmBridge.pythonCommand.description: Python command used to run the assembly line pipeline from the extension.
